verdict.rationale: Silencing notifications with a Do Not Disturb mode is a fair question for a desktop operating system, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions Do Not Disturb, Focus modes, or any notification-silencing control. The only notification-related item is Safari Notify Me (macos-docs-34), which sends alerts rather than silencing them, so it is adjacent and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can silence notifications using a Do Not Disturb mode
